title: Unit 11: Help!: Reported Questions & Requests
objective: Mampu menggunakan verbs followed by gerund or infinitive, struktur to/in order to/so as to untuk menyatakan tujuan, serta so and such untuk penekanan. Mampu memahami dan menggunakan kosakata terkait bahaya, keselamatan, dan adjectives dengan negative prefixes.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas penggunaan kata kerja yang diikuti gerund atau infinitive, cara menyatakan tujuan dengan to/in order to/so as to, serta penggunaan so dan such untuk memberikan penekanan pada kalimat. Topik ini sangat berguna untuk menjelaskan alasan dan tujuan dalam situasi darurat atau penyelamatan.
rules: Verbs followed by gerund: enjoy, (don't) mind, (can't) stand, finish, imagine, feel like, suggest, practise, miss, avoid. Contoh: He enjoyed helping people.
Verbs followed by infinitive: hope, promise, learn, expect, decide, afford, offer, choose, want. Contoh: Mr Reeder decided to do something.
to + infinitive untuk menyatakan tujuan. Contoh: The farmer ran over to see what had happened.
in order to / so as to + infinitive untuk tujuan yang lebih formal. Contoh: He couldn't throw a rope down in order to pull the donkey out.
so + adjective/adverb untuk penekanan. Contoh: I'm so hungry!
such + (a/an) + (adjective) + noun untuk penekanan. Contoh: The Prime Minister is such a good-looking man.
so/such ... that untuk menunjukkan hasil. Contoh: We were so late that we had to take a taxi.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampur Gerund dan Infinitive
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula bingung kapan menggunakan gerund (-ing) dan kapan menggunakan infinitive (to + verb). Kesalahan umum adalah menggunakan bentuk yang salah setelah kata kerja tertentu.
commonTrap.wrong: He avoided to walk along the seafront. / I hope seeing you soon.
commonTrap.correct: He avoided walking along the seafront. / I hope to see you soon.

dialogue.context: Percakapan tentang kisah kepahlawanan Mr Reeder yang menyelamatkan bayi dari kecelakaan di laut

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: Mr Reeder, can you tell us what happened that morning?
lines.translation: Pak Reeder, bisakah Anda ceritakan apa yang terjadi pagi itu?

lines.speaker: Mr Reeder
lines.text: I was carrying out my regular duties when I heard a noise. I cycled over as fast as I could.
lines.translation: Saya sedang menjalankan tugas rutin ketika saya mendengar suara. Saya langsung bersepeda secepat mungkin.

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: What did you see when you arrived?
lines.translation: Apa yang Anda lihat saat tiba di sana?

lines.speaker: Mr Reeder
lines.text: I saw a baby's buggy in the sea. The baby was strapped into the buggy and was in the water. I went over and pulled the buggy over to the sea wall.
lines.translation: Saya melihat kereta bayi di laut. Bayinya masih terikat di kereta dan ada di dalam air. Saya menghampiri dan menarik kereta itu ke dinding laut.

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: That was incredibly brave. How did you feel?
lines.translation: Itu sangat berani sekali. Bagaimana perasaan Anda?

lines.speaker: Mr Reeder
lines.text: I didn't really think. It was everyone – from Tanya doing the CPR to the helicopter pilot. I'm just glad I could help.
lines.translation: Saya tidak sempat berpikir. Semua orang membantu – dari Tanya yang melakukan CPR hingga pilot helikopter. Saya hanya senang bisa membantu.

speakingLab.context: Latihan berbicara tentang pengalaman menyelamatkan atau ditolong seseorang dalam situasi darurat

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about helping others in emergencies. Have you ever helped someone in a difficult situation, or has anyone helped you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I once helped my neighbor when they fell down the stairs.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great! Can you tell me more about it? What did you do to help them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I called an ambulance immediately and stayed with them until help arrived. I also tried to keep them calm.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! You did exactly the right thing. How did you feel when you were helping them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I felt nervous at first, but I knew I had to stay calm to help them properly.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That shows real courage. Do you think it's important for everyone to learn basic first aid?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, definitely. It can help save lives in an emergency situation.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: He enjoyed _____ the baby and the helicopter had gone.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'enjoy' selalu diikuti oleh gerund (-ing form), bukan infinitive. Pola: enjoy + verb-ing.

quiz.question: Choose the correct form: Some other people helped _____ a rope to the buggy.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'help' bisa diikuti infinitive dengan 'to' (to tie) atau tanpa 'to' (tie). Dalam konteks formal, 'to tie' lebih umum digunakan.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of using 'in order to'? The farmer ran over _____ see what had happened.
quiz.explanation: 'To' + infinitive digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan atau maksud. 'In order to' adalah bentuk yang lebih formal dengan arti yang sama.

quiz.question: Complete with 'so' or 'such': I'm _____ hungry! Can you tell them to hurry up, please?
quiz.explanation: 'So' digunakan sebelum adjective atau adverb (so hungry, so quickly), sedangkan 'such' digunakan sebelum noun phrase (such a good person).

quiz.question: Which negative prefix fits? Mr Reeder was ___concerned about his own safety.
quiz.explanation: Prefix 'un-' digunakan dengan 'concerned' untuk membuat makna negatif. Pola umum: un- + adjective (uncomfortable, unhappy, unsafe).

quiz.question: Choose the correct verb form: They managed _____ it out of the water.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'manage' selalu diikuti oleh 'to + infinitive'. Pola: manage to do something (berhasil melakukan sesuatu).
